entries.name: Light Bolt Volley
entries.rationale: An important group-damage cast from Radiant Spellsowers; assign an interrupt rather than healing through it.

entries.name: Light Bolt
entries.rationale: Kezkitt's repeatable cast is listed among the dungeon's important interrupts.

entries.name: Disorienting Screech
entries.rationale: Stop the Lightfeather Petalwing cast to prevent its group disruption.

entries.name: Warden's Wrath
entries.rationale: A named boss interrupt on Lightwarden Ruia and a higher-priority use of the group's interrupt rotation.

entries.name: Lightspore Shot
entries.rationale: A named important interrupt during Ziekket's add phase.

entries.name: Bloodthorn Roots
entries.rationale: The root aura is a Magic debuff, but destroying the root is the planned mechanic; treat a magic dispel as recovery when that plan fails.

provenance.description: Interrupt and dispel priorities were independently summarized from Wowhead's Patch 12.1 dungeon overview.
Spell IDs, NPC contexts, interruptibility, and dispel flags are linked to the generated Midnight Season 2 ability index.
